engagement.name: sl-demo
engagement.note: Exemplar built on the PUBLIC Sierra Leone demo database (2.43 seed). Demonstrates: the 2.43 merge-endpoint path with its duplicate-COC follow-up, a UID-based SQL structural fix the API guards block, a derive-at-runtime fix with fixed pre-generated UIDs, an expression repair with server-side validation, and drift-guarded preconditions on every fix.

fixes.title: Merge duplicate category combo 'Morbidity Age' into 'Morbidity Cases' via the 2.43 merge endpoint, then dedupe the surviving combo's COCs
fixes.rationale: Both combos use the same single category ('Morbidity Age'); one has no data elements. On 2.43 the categoryCombos/merge endpoint migrates dataset overrides, data values and COCs transactionally. Its own merge report warns duplicate COCs remain in the survivor — the second step clears those with categoryOptionCombos/merge.
fixes.reversible: Control snapshot; the merge migrates rather than deletes data.

steps.note: 2.43+ only — on 2.42/2.41 this endpoint returns 405 and the fix needs the SQL merge recipe (see references/playbook.md §5/§6)

steps.code:
# the combo merge leaves duplicate COCs in the survivor (per its own merge report) — dedupe them
import collections
cc = api("GET", "/categoryCombos/t3aNCvHsoSn", params={"fields": "categoryOptionCombos[id,name,categoryOptions[id]]"}).json()
byopt = collections.defaultdict(list)
for coc in cc.get("categoryOptionCombos", []):
    byopt[tuple(sorted(o["id"] for o in coc.get("categoryOptions", [])))].append(coc)
for grp in (v for v in byopt.values() if len(v) > 1):
    target, sources = grp[0]["id"], [x["id"] for x in grp[1:]]
    _say(f"merging duplicate COCs {[x['name'] for x in grp[1:]]} -> {grp[0]['name']!r}")
    api("POST", "/categoryOptionCombos/merge", body={"sources": sources, "target": target, "deleteSources": True, "dataMergeStrategy": "LAST_UPDATED"})
api("POST", "/maintenance", params={"cacheClear": "true", "categoryOptionComboUpdate": "true"})
steps.note: derive the duplicate groups at runtime — the summary under-reports them

fixes.title: Fix the 'Births' combo's wrong category (Gender -> Location PHU/Community) — resolves 12 disjoint COCs, moves NO data
fixes.rationale: The Births combo is defined as [Births attended by x Gender] but all 12 of its COCs actually use [Births attended by x Location PHU/Community] ('Trained TBA, In Community' etc.) — the combo references the wrong category while the data already sits under the correct COCs. No merge endpoint does a category swap and E1120 blocks the API edit while data exists, so this is the one legitimately-SQL structural fix even on 2.43.
fixes.reversible: Single-row UPDATE; swap back to the Gender category UID.

preconditions.code: any(c["id"] == "cX5k9anHEHd" for c in api("GET", "/categoryCombos/m2jTvAj5kkm", params={"fields": "categories[id]"}).json().get("categories", []))
preconditions.note: the Births combo still (wrongly) references the Gender category — skip if already fixed

steps.statement: UPDATE categorycombos_categories SET categoryid=(SELECT categoryid FROM category WHERE uid='x3uo8LqiTBk') WHERE categorycomboid=(SELECT categorycomboid FROM categorycombo WHERE uid='m2jTvAj5kkm') AND categoryid=(SELECT categoryid FROM category WHERE uid='cX5k9anHEHd')
steps.note: UID-based subqueries — never hardcode internal numeric ids
steps.guard: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categorycombos_categories cc JOIN categorycombo c ON c.categorycomboid=cc.categorycomboid JOIN category g ON g.categoryid=cc.categoryid WHERE c.uid='m2jTvAj5kkm' AND g.uid='cX5k9anHEHd')

fixes.title: Create an 'Other/unknown' group in each compulsory OU dimension (Facility Ownership, Facility Type, Location Rural/Urban); bucket unclassified OUs and move exclusive conflicts into it
fixes.rationale: The uncovered OUs are mostly admin-hierarchy levels with no facility classification; conflicted OUs carry contradictory memberships. An explicit Other/unknown bucket keeps each dimension complete and compulsory without fabricating classifications.
fixes.reversible: Delete the 3 groups by their fixed UIDs; original memberships are in the control snapshot.

preconditions.note: identity guard: the target has the dimension this fix was developed against

steps.note: fixed pre-generated UIDs: idempotent, portable, reversible; shells are also emitted to the import package
membership is DERIVED at runtime (logic step) — never hardcode thousands of OU UIDs

fixes.title: Repair validation rules wrapping a single operand in AVG() — strip the unsupported wrapper
fixes.rationale: Validation-rule expressions do not support aggregation functions; AVG(x) over a single operand is a no-op wrapper, so stripping it is deterministic. Every candidate repair is validated server-side (GET /api/expressions/description) before writing; anything that does not validate is left and flagged.
fixes.reversible: Re-wrap in AVG() (original expressions in the control snapshot).

steps.note: NB /api/expressions/description is a GET (POST returns 405 and would reject every good fix)

fixes.title: Give users data-view access to their capture org units
fixes.rationale: Users could enter data at org units they could not see in analytics; standard fix is data-view ⊇ capture.
fixes.reversible: Original dataViewOrganisationUnits are in the control snapshot.
